cs.t: I am gonna be a bit off-course and say, whichever laptop you have could be the best if you play to its strengths. I used Asus x205ta laptop and it still is one of my best investments. Elsewhere on HN, i have mentioned that i setup vagrant and used the machine to its best. All i cared was to have a browser and a terminal. :) EDIT : Asus x205ta is a $199-ish netbook.. with an atom processor and 2gb ram, 11-inch screen. Currently i use an MBA (2015) model.
